**Minecraft 26.x | Fabric and NeoForge**

Highlights every occurrence of a block pattern near you. Patterns are built from
per-cell predicates (block ids, tags, alternations, any-block and negations),
and several can be searched for at once, each in its own colour.

Entirely client-side: it reads blocks the client already has and draws boxes
locally, so it is safe on servers that do not have it installed.

- `blockgrep-fabric-${VERSION}.jar` — Fabric (requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api))
- `blockgrep-neoforge-${VERSION}.jar` — NeoForge
